title: Create: Quarry
description: A Create addon that adds an automated, rotational-power-driven Quarry: link two Quarry Stakes to define a rectangular mining area, then let the Quarry excavate it layer by layer, filtering ores, replacing mined terrain, and optionally draining fluids.
body:
Create: Quarry

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gLTAirKi/images/1c202792924d4fba8065d8179ea75ee38691826b.gif) **A Create addon that adds a fully automated Quarry, powered by rotational force.** Link a pair of Quarry Stakes to mark out an area, connect the Quarry to a Create kinetic network, and watch it methodically strip-mine the ground below, layer by layer.
## ✨ Features * Link two **Quarry Stakes** to define a rectangular mining area of (almost) any size * Scans and extracts layer by layer, replacing mined blocks with a configurable fallback (stone, deepslate, netherrack, end stone, …) * Filter what gets extracted with a single item or any Create Filter — or default to mining ore tags automatically * Powered entirely by Create rotational force; scan speed scales with RPM * **Enchantable Quarry block** — apply Efficiency, Fortune or Silk Touch at an enchanting table to boost mining speed and change the drops * Optional fluid collection into an adjacent Fluid Tank * Optional chunk loading so the Quarry keeps working while you're away * Live tooltip readout: current state, progress, Y level, blocks scanned and ores extracted * Deeply configurable: stress impact, scan speed, ore tags, blacklists, dimension fallbacks and more
## ⚙️ How to Use Place two **Quarry Stakes** at opposite corners of the area you want mined, and right-click each with a **Wrench** to link them together. Place the **Quarry** block above the area, connect it to a Create rotational power source, and give it an adjacent inventory (like an Item Vault) to store its output. Optionally right-click the Quarry's front face with a single item — or any Create Filter — to restrict what it mines, and connect a Fluid Tank if you want it to also collect fluids it drains. The Quarry itself can be enchanted at an enchanting table (or with an anvil/enchanted book) just like a tool: **Efficiency** speeds up scanning (at the cost of extra Stress Impact), **Fortune** boosts ore drops, and **Silk Touch** collects blocks as-is instead of their normal drops.
